{{Quote|This is Captain Feylara Raed of the free trader vessel ''Celestial Crow''. If anyone's out there, I need help!|Feylara Raed|<ref name="Distressed" />}}
'''Feylara Raed''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Celestial Crow]]'' during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. One of the many ex-girlfriends of a [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]] named [[Skavak/Legends|Skavak]], she tried to please her ex-lover by setting a trap for his nemesis, the future [[Voidhound]], who was traveling with another of Skavak's former "allies": [[Risha Drayen]]. Feylara stranded her ship in the deep space somewhere in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] and send a fake distress signal asking for help. When the Voidhound docked the [[XS stock light freighter/Legends|XS stock light freighter]] to the Celestial Crow, she commanded the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to kill them, while protecting herself with an [[Ray shield/Legends|energy shield]]. However, all of her droids were [[Skirmish aboard the Celestial Crow|defeated]] and the shield's energy source ran out, leaving her defenseless and vulnerable. The Voidhound forgave Feylara and left, after explaining to her Skavak's abusive and fickle nature.<ref name="Distressed" />
